Hi @yusukebe I think so. In issue #4108, it appears that when the postfix is [], the return value is: - string | File when there is a single element - (string | File)[] when there are two or more elements However, the type is defined as `(string | File)[]`, which does not match the actual return value when there is only one element.
It should `resolve` when in the `close` event. Otherwise, the test will fail.
